The '''Cheku system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Brevost sector/Legends|Brevost sector]], a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] region.<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the group known as the [[Chekut]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cheku system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-15. Within the book, the Cheku system was erroneously placed in grid square O-14 on a map depicting the events of the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Confederation–Galactic Alliance War]].<ref name="TEA" />
